about.en: GEODNET (Global Earth Observation Decentralized Network) is a decentralized network of GNSS reference stations that supplies real-time kinematic (RTK) corrections for centimetre-level satellite positioning. GEOD is its token, rewarded to the operators who run the stations; it is issued on Polygon at 0xac0f66379a6d7801d7726d5a943356a172549adb and on Solana at 7JA5eZdCzztSfQbJvS8aVVxMFfd81Rs9VvwnocV1mKHu.
